title: Folkloric Silkscreen
description: Art folklorique numérique contemporain imitant la sérigraphie du milieu du siècle. Défini par une palette strictement limitée et très contrastée de couleurs unies, utilisant des textures risographiques pointillées et des motifs botaniques décoratifs au lieu d'ombrages traditionnels.
description_en: Contemporary digital folk art mimicking mid-century silkscreen prints. Defined by a strictly limited, high-contrast palette of solid flat colors, utilizing stippled risograph textures and decorative botanical motifs instead of traditional shading.
description_fr: Art folklorique numérique contemporain imitant la sérigraphie du milieu du siècle. Défini par une palette strictement limitée et très contrastée de couleurs unies, utilisant des textures risographiques pointillées et des motifs botaniques décoratifs au lieu d'ombrages traditionnels.
prompt: Contemporary digital folk art illustration mimicking mid-century silkscreen printing and risograph aesthetics. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Flat vector-style rendering with absolutely no gradients. Flat, unlit composition. Zero directional lighting, no cast shadows, no highlights. The palette is strictly limited and highly contrasting, dominated by deep {{primary_color}} fields, punctuated by vibrant flat shapes of {{accent_color}}, with details picked out in stark {{secondary_color}}. Subjects and environments are simplified into bold, stylized silhouettes. Forms are built from solid, opaque color blocks without outlines. Internal details are rendered as decorative overlays—dots, dashes, and simplified botanical or geometric folk motifs. The interaction between positive and negative space is crucial, with {{secondary_color}} often used as negative cutouts to define internal anatomy or architectural lines. Edges are mostly crisp and graphic but feature a subtle, uniform stippled noise or ink-bleed grit, simulating physical printmaking on textured paper. 2D stacked perspective. Depth is achieved purely through overlapping flat planes and contrasting color boundaries, maintaining a heavily graphic, collage-like spatial dynamic. The overall atmosphere is graphic, nostalgic, and deeply illustrative, relying on rhythmic pattern repetition. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. contemporary folk art, silkscreen print, risograph texture, flat colors, limited palette, geometric motifs, high contrast, stippling, unlit, 2d illustration, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame
